name: validate-schematron
description: Validates XML/TEI documents against Schematron rules (from a .sch, an ODD or a RelaxNG with embedded rules) and, optionally, RelaxNG structure via jing. Results appear as diagnostics in the editor and the Problems panel.

schematron.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter with saxonche and lxml installed (e.g. a virtualenv's bin/python).

schematron.validatorPath.description: Path to validate.py. Empty: use the copy bundled with the extension. Point it at your own checkout to use the ODD route (-o), which needs odds/extract-isosch.xsl next to the script.

schematron.schema.description: Schema to validate against (relative to the workspace folder). Empty: auto-detect from the document's <?xml-model?> processing instructions.

enumDescriptions: RelaxNG generated from an ODD: its embedded Schematron is harvested (-r)
ISO Schematron file, used as is (-s)
ODD with embedded Schematron, extracted with extract-isosch.xsl (-o)
schematron.schemaType.description: Type of the file in schematron.schema (ignored when auto-detecting).

schematron.validateOnOpen.description: Validate XML files when they are opened.

schematron.validateOnSave.description: Validate XML files when they are saved.

schematron.relaxng.enabled.description: Also check structure with jing when the schema source is a RelaxNG file.

schematron.jingPath.description: jing executable for the RelaxNG layer.

schematron.timeoutSeconds.description: Abort a validation run after this many seconds.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run bundle-validator
